points.label: Creation setting
points.left: The language explicitly connects forming the earth with habitation and purpose.
points.right: The world becomes habitable through gathered water, visible ground, and food-bearing plant life.

points.label: Parties, action, or promise
points.left: Creator and former · Earth · Form · make · establish · Empty description · inhabited purpose
points.right: Land · seas · Gathering · appearing · producing · Vegetation · seed · fruit · Seed-bearing continuity

payload.posture: Isaiah’s statement about an inhabited earth recalls Genesis’ movement from gathered waters to land and vegetation.
payload.tension: Isaiah states a purpose in prophetic argument; Genesis narrates ordered land, seas, and seed-bearing growth.
payload.title: Earth formed to be inhabited / land made habitable
